Rajya Sabha
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, August 6, 2024/ Sravana 15, 1946 Saka
(Ministries : Ayush;Chemicals and Fertilizers;Consumer Affairs, Food and Public
Distribution;Corporate Affairs;Finance;Health and Family Welfare;New and
Renewable Energy;Ports, Shipping and Waterways)
Total number of questions -- 15
New Government medical colleges in West Bengal
151Shri Samik Bhattacharya:
Will the Minister ofHealth and Family Welfarebe pleased to state:
(a) whether Government intends to set up one medical college in every district of West
Bengal;
(b) whether Government is aware that that there is no medical colleges in Dakshin Dinajpur,
Alipurduar, Kalimpong and Paschim Burdwan districts of West Bengal;
(c) whether the Central Government has received any proposal from the State Government
for establishing medical colleges in these districts;and
(d) the current ratio of aspiring medical students to available seats in existing medical
colleges in West Bengal?
Compensation to customers in case of fraud/ e-fraud
152Shri A. D. Singh:
Will the Minister ofFinancebe pleased to state:
(a) the bank-wise rules regarding payment of compensation to customers in case of
fraud/e-fraud reported by the customer within the prescribed time;
(b) the RBI guidelines in this regard;
(c) the number of cases in which the Banks have given compensations in the last two
years, the details thereof, bank-wise;and
(d) the details of amount lost by the customers and the compensation paid by the banks in
the last two years, bank-wise?
Beneficiaries under PMGKAY
153Shri Vikramjit Singh Sahney:
Will the Minister ofConsumer Affairs, Food and Public Distributionbe pleased to
state:
(a) the total number of beneficiaries benefited under the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna
Yojana (PMGKAY) across the country, State-wise;
(b) the total number of beneficiaries benefited through PMGKAY in the State of Punjab,
district-wise;
(c) the major initiatives taken by the Ministry to ensure better implementation and 100 per
cent food distribution in the State of Punjab;
(d)the list of foodgrains which are beingdistributed under the scheme, State-wise;and
51

(e) whether Government is planning to add millets as well in the PMGKAY food grains?
National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission
154Dr. Ashok Kumar Mittal:
Will the Minister ofHealth and Family Welfarebe pleased to state:
(a) the current status of implementation of the National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination
Mission launched in 2023, including details of screening conducted and counselling provided
in affected tribal regions;
(b) the steps being taken to improve access to modern medications, including hydroxyurea
and other disease-modifying therapies, for patients with Sickle Cell Disease (SCD),
particularly in tribal and rural areas;
(c) whether Government is considering initiatives to promote research in gene therapy and
other advanced treatments for SCD in the country, if so, the details thereof;and
(d) the measures being implemented to strengthen healthcare infrastructure, improve early
diagnosis and enhance community engagement to combat SCD?
Bridge construction over the river Brahmaputra National Waterway-2
155Shri Ajit Kumar Bhuyan:
Will the Minister ofPorts, Shipping and Waterwaysbe pleased to state:
(a) the number of bridges which are under construction over the river Brahmaputra,
National Waterway-2;
(b) whether any clearance or no-objection is necessary before construction of a bridge in
any National Waterway and the parameters that need to be followed for maintaining
navigational clearance;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether the Ministry is aware that a bridge between Guwahati and North Guwahati over
the river Brahmaputra is under construction and whether any NoC or clearance has been
given by the Ministry;and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Ayurveda-Traditional system of Medicine
156 #Dr. Kalpana Saini:
Will the Minister ofAyushbe pleased to state:
(a) whether a large section of the country's population depends on traditional systems of
medicine in which Ayurveda is prominent;
(b) if so, the details thereof;and
(c) the details of efforts being made by Government to promote various traditional systems
of medicine including Ayurveda and major achievements thereof?
Cases under PMLA
157Shri Javed Ali Khan:
Will the Minister ofFinancebe pleased to state:
(a) the number of cases registered/notices sent under PMLA Act by Enforcement
Directorate since 2019 till date, year-wise;
(b) the number of cases in which chargesheets have been filed out of the above, year-wise;
(c) the names of private companies against which Enforcement Directorate has filed cases
under PMLA Act since 2019 till 31st July, 2024, year-wise and company-wise;and
(d) the names of private companies against which Enforcement Directorate has closed the
cases under PMLA since 2019 to 31st July, 2024, year-wise and company-wise?

Promotion of renewable

Rajya Sabha
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, August 6, 2024/ Sravana 15, 1946 Saka
(Ministries : Ayush;Chemicals and Fertilizers;Consumer Affairs, Food and Public
Distribution;Corporate Affairs;Finance;Health and Family Welfare;New and
Renewable Energy;Ports, Shipping and Waterways)
Total number of questions -- 160
Establishment of Ayush health and wellness centres
1601Shri G.C. Chandrashekhar:
Will the Minister ofAyushbe pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has initiated any efforts to establish dedicated Ayush health and
wellness centres under the Ayushman Bharat Mission, considering the role of Ayush in
enhancing healthcare quality in 'New India';
(b) if so, the details of these initiatives;and
(c) if not, whether Government would explain the reasons for not undertaking such
initiatives?
Production and processing of medicinal plants
1602Shri G.C. Chandrashekhar:
Will the Minister ofAyushbe pleased to state:
(a) the steps taken to train farmers across various States on Good Agricultural Practices
(GAP) and Good Field Collection Practices (GFCP) for medicinal plants;and
(b) the achievements of Government in promoting the production and processing of herbs
and medicinal plants through these initiatives?
Research in Ayush institutes and wellness centers
1603 #Shri Naresh Bansal:
Will the Minister ofAyushbe pleased to state:
(a) whether, with the recent inclusion of Ayurveda, Unani, and Sidhha (ASU) nomenclature
in the International Classification of Disease (ICD-11), TM Module 2 by WHO, Government
would provide details on the research-based initiatives that would be undertaken by Ayush
to promote its effectiveness through Ayush wellness centers;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government plans to expand its research initiatives in collaboration with Ayush-
ICMR Advanced Centre for Integrated Health Research which will be established in select
AIIMS;and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Promotion of traditional Indian systems of medicine in Odisha
1604Shri Muzibulla Khan:
Will the Minister ofAyushbe pleased to state:
374

(a) the specific initiatives Government has undertaken to promote Ayush systems of
medicine, including Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homoeopathy, in the
State of Odisha;and
(b) the update on the establishment and functioning of Ayush hospitals, dispensaries, and
wellness centers in rural and urban areas of Odisha?
Traditional Indian systems of medicine
1605Shri Muzibulla Khan:
Will the Minister ofAyushbe pleased to state:
(a) the steps Government is taking to promote and integrate traditional Indian systems of
medicine, such as Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homoeopathy, into the
mainstream healthcare system;and
(b) the update on the research initiatives and clinical trials being conducted by Government
to validate the efficacy and safety of Ayush treatments for various health conditions?
Availability and improvement of alternative medicine services
1606 #Shri Tejveer Singh:
Will the Minister ofAyushbe pleased to state:
(a) the major schemes and initiatives taken so far by Government to increase the
availability of Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy system of medicines;and
(b) the new steps Government is taking to improve the quality and accessibility of these
medical services and the corrective plans being made keeping future in mind?
Research in Ayush sector
1607Shri Sanjay Seth:
Will the Minister ofAyushbe pleased to state:
(a) the current research initiatives undertaken by Government in the Ayush sector in the last
five years particularly in Uttar Pradesh;
(b) the details of fund that has been allocated to support Ayush research and development
projects in the past three years;
(c) the measures implemented/being implemented to encourage collaboration between
Ayush institutions, academia and industry for research and innovation;and
(d) the steps being taken to ensure that research outcomes in Ayush are effectively
disseminated and integrated into healthcare practices nation-wide?
Incentives for entrepreneurs for starting new ventures of Ayurvedic centres
1608Shri Sanjeev Arora:
Will the Minister ofAyushbe pleased to state:
(a) the incentives given to entrepreneurs by Government for starting new ventures of
Ayurvedic centres;and
(b) the incentives given for plantation used as basic raw materials for Ayurvedic medicines?
Medical heritage
1609 #Dr. Kalpana Saini:
Will the Minister ofAyushbe pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Institute of Indian Medical Heritage (NIMH), Hyderabad has been
designated as the first WHO collaborating centre for fundamental and literary research in
traditional medicine;and
(b) the advantages of such a field for traditional medicine in the country?
375

Randomised clinical trials for Ayush medicines

Will the Minister ofAyushbe pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has implemented provisions for conducting
